import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest

X = pd.DataFrame({"a": [-1.1, 0.3, 0.5, 100.0]})
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    m = IsolationForest(random_state=0, contamination=0.05).fit(X)
    msgs = [str(x.message) for x in w if issubclass(x.category, UserWarning)]
print("FIT-WARNINGS:", msgs)
print("OFFSET:", m.offset_)
pct = np.percentile(m.score_samples(X), 5.0)
print("OFFSET-CONSISTENT:", bool(np.isclose(m.offset_, pct)))
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w2:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    preds = m.predict(X)
    msgs2 = [str(x.message) for x in w2 if issubclass(x.category, UserWarning)]
print("PREDICT-WARNINGS:", msgs2, "PREDICT-OK:", set(preds) <= {-1, 1})
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
Xs = csr_matrix(np.abs(np.random.RandomState(0).randn(20, 3)))
ms = IsolationForest(random_state=0, contamination=0.1).fit(Xs)
print("SPARSE-PREDICT-OK:", set(ms.predict(Xs)) <= {-1, 1})
